text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer witnessed Sakura Laurel's 
spectacular debut race. The nightmares of 
her legs breaking down faded away, 
replaced by a blossoming sense of new 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer finds themselves wishing 
strongly once more to chase the dream of 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe together 
with Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the day after the race, Sakura 
Laurel had to sit out of training due to 
poor health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Sakura Laurel does not look down. 
She continues to move forward, doing 
whatever she can right now. She showed 
fierce determination for next year's 
Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, they decided to 
monitor the condition of her legs and 
build up her record by entering races 
without overexerting her.
